{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the distribution of the 'status' column
status_counts = sales_df['status'].value_counts()

# Identify the actual completed orders
# According to the data dictionary, 'completed' means the order was successfully processed
# and not refunded
completed_orders = status_counts.get('completed', 0)

# Confirm that 'refunded' is not included in completed orders
# The data dictionary confirms that 'refunded' indicates a refund, so it should not be counted
refunded_orders = status_counts.get('refunded', 0)

# Print results
completed_orders, refunded_orders"}
